name: @chethandvg/synthesis-theory
description: Beats, FM sidebands, free-bar mode ratios and Karplus-Strong strings in Rust, Python and WebAssembly, proved in Lean 4 or verified numerically.
author: Chethan Dandebala Venkatarama

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/node target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/synthesis_theory_wasm.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg/web target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/synthesis_theory_wasm.wasm
